assertions.claim: Pool of 126 studies, 72k+ people: higher marital quality, better health, but the association is weak
assertions.cn_span: 126 篇研究、7.2 万多人的汇总显示，婚姻质量越高健康越好，但这个关联很弱

assertions.claim: Magnitude comparable to diet-type health behaviors' effect on health; essentially no male-female difference found
assertions.cn_span: 量级跟饮食这类健康行为对健康的影响差不多，男女之间基本没发现差别

assertions.claim: Judge relationship quality by several conflicts and months of living together, not by checking a trait checklist
assertions.cn_span: 关系好不好要拿几次冲突、几个月相处去看，不是核对条件清单

assertions.claim: 'Is a bad marriage worse than no marriage' has no direct comparative data; currently only an inference
assertions.cn_span: 至于「坏婚姻是不是比不结婚更差」，没有直接对比的数据，目前只是推论

assertions.claim: Effect sizes r 0.07-0.21; death risk r=0.11; cardiovascular reaction in conflict r=-0.13
assertions.cn_span: 效应量 r 在 0.07 到 0.21 之间，其中死亡风险 r = 0.11、冲突时心血管反应 r = −0.13
